scripts.start: pnpm env:sync && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n be,fe -c blue,green "pnpm start:be" "pnpm start:fe"
scripts.start:web: pnpm env:sync && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n be,fe -c blue,green "pnpm start:be" "pnpm start:fe:web"
scripts.lint:check: pnpm --prefix alzan-be lint:check && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe lint:check
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --prefix alzan-be lint:fix && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe lint:fix
scripts.format:check: pnpm --prefix alzan-be format:check && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe format:check
scripts.format: pnpm --prefix alzan-be format && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe format
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --prefix alzan-be typecheck && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe typecheck
scripts.install:all: pnpm --prefix alzan-be install && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe install
scripts.supabase:types:fe: supabase gen types --local > alzan-fe/src/types/database.types.ts && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe format
scripts.supabase:types:be: supabase gen types --local > alzan-be/src/types/database.types.ts && pnpm --prefix alzan-be format
